For the effect of phenobarbital on metronida- zole, see p.838. Antipsychotics. As with all antiepileptics, antipsychotics may antagonise the antiepileptic activity of phenobarbital by lowering the convulsive threshold. For the effect of phenobarbital on antipsychotics, see under Chlorpromazine, p.974. Antivirals. A patient stabilised on phenobarbital 100 mg daily had an episode of seizures 4 weeks after starting HAART therapy with abacavir, didanosine, ritonavir-boosted tipranavir, and enfu- virtide.1 The patient’s phenobarbital plasma concentrations had fallen from 16 to 8 micrograms/mL and an increase in the phe- nobarbital dosage to 150 mg daily was required to restore con- centrations.
